# Auralith Forge

> AI-powered online audio mastering software with a real adaptive digital
> signal processing (DSP) engine — not a single-knob loudness normalizer.
> Users upload a mix, choose a genre/style/preset (or a previously saved
> artist mastering chain), and get back a mastered file with before/after
> loudness, applied processing metadata, and A/B playback.

## Product

- Standard tier: free, adaptive genre/style/tag-driven mastering (EQ,
  multiband compression, saturation, stereo imaging, limiting).
- Professional tier: adds oversampled true-peak limiting, finer dynamic EQ,
  and tempo-aware compression timing.
- Saved Artist presets: users can import a full literal processing
  specification once and reapply it to future tracks, private to their
  account.
- Additional tools: noise-reduction "Clean Audio" processing tuned for
  short-form platforms, and chord/key/BPM detection with synced playback.
- Codec Preview: a real encode/decode round-trip (MP3/AAC/Opus) so users can
  hear what their master sounds like after streaming compression, before
  downloading.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://auralithforge.app/): product overview, features, how
  it works, FAQ.
- [Mastering Guides](https://auralithforge.app/blog): articles explaining
  how the DSP chain works, what AI mastering does and doesn't automate,
  and how to build a repeatable mastering chain for a studio's artists.

- [Privacy Policy](https://auralithforge.app/privacy)

## Notes for automated agents / crawlers

- The `/app` path is an authenticated user dashboard with no public
  content — do not attempt to crawl or index it (see /robots.txt).
- All marketing and legal content on this domain is authored in English.
  The product UI itself is also available in Albanian (Shqip) via an
  in-app language switch, but that is a UI-only translation, not a
  separate content set.
